- **Ising machine**: Hardware built to search for the lowest energy of an Ising model. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#ising-machine))_
- **Jarzynski equality**: ⟨e^(−W/kT)⟩ = e^(−ΔF/kT): a free energy difference read from the work of many fast, non-equilibrium pulls. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#jarzynski))_
- **KL divergence**: D(p‖q) = Σ p ln(p/q): what coding p with a code built for q costs over the right code. It is never negative. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#kl-divergence))_
- **Landauer**: Landauer's principle: erasing one bit costs at least kT ln 2 of heat. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#landauer))_
- **Langevin drift**: Moving real numbers downhill on their energy plus a little noise set by the temperature. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#langevin))_
- **logits**: The raw scores a network outputs before the softmax turns them into probabilities. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#logits))_
- **magnetic tunnel junction**: Two magnetic layers around a thin insulator; made unstable on purpose, its resistance flips at random and it serves as one physical p-bit. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#magnetic-tunnel-junction))_
- **magnetisation**: The average spin of a lattice: how ordered it is. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#magnetisation))_
- **Markov blanket**: The things a thing depends on directly; given them, it is independent of everything else. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#markov-blanket))_
- **Maxwell's demon**: Maxwell's imagined sorter of fast and slow molecules; erasing the demon's memory costs at least the entropy it saved, as Landauer's principle requires. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#maxwells-demon))_
- **mean field**: An approximation that replaces each neighbour by its average and solves one unit at a time. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mean-field))_
- **Metropolis**: A sampling rule that proposes a flip and accepts it with probability min(1, e^(-ΔE/T)). _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#metropolis))_
- **mirror image**: A stored pattern with every pixel reversed. The pulls record only which pixels agree with which, so it is a valley as well: E(-s) = E(s). _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mirror-image))_
- **mixing time**: How long a sampler must run before its samples no longer depend on where it started. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mixing-time))_
- **mixture of experts**: A layer of many expert networks with a router that sends each token to only a few of them, so most weights rest on any one token. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mixture-of-experts))_
- **MNIST**: A standard set of handwritten digits, 28 by 28 pixels, used to test a learning machine. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mnist))_
- **Monte Carlo**: Estimating a sum or an average by drawing random samples. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#monte-carlo))_
- **Nishimori temperature**: The temperature at which settling a decoder gives the best bit-by-bit guess for a given channel noise. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#nishimori-temperature))_
- **noise-contrastive estimation**: Learning a density by learning to tell data from samples of a known noise distribution. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#noise-contrastive-estimation))_
- **p-bit**: A probabilistic bit: a coin that comes up +1 or -1, biased by its input through the tanh rule. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#p-bit))_
- **parallel tempering**: Copies of a system run at several temperatures and swap states now and then, so the cold copy escapes its traps. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#parallel-tempering))_
- **partition function**: Z, the sum of e^(−E/T) over every state: the number that turns Boltzmann weights into probabilities. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#partition-function))_
- **perplexity**: e raised to the cross-entropy: the number of equally likely choices a model is as unsure as. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#perplexity))_
- **PGM**: Plain picture files: PGM holds one grey value a pixel, PPM three colour values a pixel. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#pgm))_
- **phase transition**: A sharp change of order as the temperature crosses a critical point. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#phase-transition))_
- **probabilistic computer**: A machine built of p-bits that samples from a distribution instead of computing one answer. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#probabilistic-computer))_
- **PSNR**: Peak signal-to-noise ratio, in dB, of a picture read from a settle. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#psnr))_
- **Purkinje cell**: The large neuron of the cerebellar cortex; Marr and Albus read the cerebellum as a memory, and Kanerva saw an SDM in it. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#purkinje-cell))_
- **quantum annealing**: Annealing that crosses energy barriers by quantum tunnelling instead of by heat. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#quantum-annealing))_
- **QUBO**: A cost written as a quadratic in 0/1 variables; it turns into leans and pulls directly. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#qubo))_
- **replica**: A way to average ln Z over random pulls: compute the average of Z^n for n copies of the system, and let n go to 0. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#replica))_
- **restricted Boltzmann machine**: A Boltzmann machine with pulls only between a visible layer and a hidden layer, never within a layer. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#restricted-boltzmann-machine))_
- **sample**: One recorded arrangement of the machine; counting samples estimates probabilities. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sample))_
- **score matching**: Fitting the gradient of the log density (the score) instead of the density, so the partition function is never needed. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#score-matching))_
- **Settling**: Sampling by re-tossing one thing at a time, so that every arrangement turns up with probability proportional to e^(-E/T). _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settling))_
- **simulated annealing**: Settling while slowly lowering the temperature, so the machine ends in a deep valley. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#simulated-annealing))_
- **softmax**: Turns scores into probabilities: e to each score over T, divided by the sum of them all. It is the Boltzmann distribution of the scores. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#softmax))_
- **sparsity**: Most units silent at once, so each pattern uses only a few. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#sparsity))_
- **spin glass**: Spins coupled by random pulls of both signs: an energy landscape of countless valleys. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#spin-glass))_
- **stochastic computing**: Computing on random bit streams in which the share of 1s carries the number; a gate that gives 1 only when both its inputs are 1 then multiplies two numbers. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#stochastic-computing))_
- **stochastic resonance**: A weak periodic signal made easier to detect by adding the right amount of noise. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#stochastic-resonance))_
- **superposition**: Many patterns stored on the same weights at once. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#superposition))_
- **tanh rule**: P(yes) = (1 + tanh(I / T)) / 2, where I is a thing's lean plus its pulls times its neighbours. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#tanh-rule))_
- **TAP**: A correction to the leans that aim at a picture: subtract what the neighbours already push, and add back the part of that push which is the pixel's own influence reflected by its neighbours. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#tap-correction))_
- **temperature**: How random the tosses are; β = 1/T. Hot is noisy, cold follows the energy closely. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#temperature))_
- **thermodynamic computing**: Computing with hardware that settles toward equilibrium, so that its own thermal noise does the sampling. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#thermodynamic-computing))_
- **transformer**: A network of stacked attention layers and small feed-forward nets; the shape of today's large language models. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#transformer))_
- **UCI optical digits**: The small set of 8x8 handwritten digits bundled with scikit-learn. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#uci-digits))_
- **variational inference**: Approximating a hard distribution with a simpler q chosen to lower a free energy, the negative ELBO. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#variational-inference))_
- **walker**: One copy of the numbers moving under the drift, or one trained model in a set; a cloud is many walkers. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#walker))_

## settle-mcp tool

- **check_system**: Check this machine for what SETTLE needs (rustc, cargo, git, node) by running only version commands. Shows each command it ran. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **explain_error**: Explain a SETTLE error message: the documented cause, where it is documented, and a tested program that produces it. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **get_example**: Show one tested example: its program and the exact output (or error) the interpreter is tested to produce. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **help**: Explain SETTLE, KANERVA and this server. With a topic, look the word up in the glossary built from the site and its docs; "glossary" lists every name. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **kanerva_quickstart**: Run the KANERVA crate's own quickstart example: build a memory, write 300 patterns, read one back, predict capacity, refuse, a keyed note and the soft machine. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **list_examples**: List the tested example programs from the SETTLE docs, each with its first comment line. Filter by family or by kind (ok or error). _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **read_doc**: Read one SETTLE, KANERVA or site document by name (for example "03-syntax", "sdm", "kanerva://readme", "what"); with no name, list them. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **run_program**: Run a SETTLE program, from a .settle file or from program text, and return what it printed, its errors and its exit code. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **sdm_store_recall**: Write named patterns (or short texts) into a sparse distributed memory, then read one back from a noisy read-address. Shows the SETTLE program it ran. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **setup**: Fetch, build and verify SETTLE and KANERVA in a folder. Dry run by default: returns every command and a plan id. Run it with dry_run false and confirm set to that id. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_
- **setup_status**: Report a setup that is still running in the background, step by step, or the last setup this server ran. _(sites/settle-site/src/data/mcpDocs.js)_

## SETTLE family

- **coded**: Compress and error-code text before storing it in a memory; decode on recall. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **colour**: Three grids per colour picture: PPM in and out, colour playback. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **core**: Things, leans and pulls; `hold`, `settle`, `anneal`, `show`, `best`, `ask`. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **denoise**: A chain of small machines trained to turn coin noise into examples. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **descend**: Gradient descent as Settling: parameters on any differentiable loss, Langevin above temperature 0, the posterior cloud. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **export**: Write a model as Ising, QUBO, Gset or DIMACS; read an Ising file back. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **grid**: One thing per pixel: read and write PGM pictures, play a folder of frames. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **ldpcmoves**: Multi-bit moves and Nishimori-temperature decoding for those codes. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **ldpcsettle**: LDPC error-correcting codes as springs; decode by settling or belief propagation. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **learn**: Example sets, hidden things, Boltzmann machine learning, classification by settling. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **memory**: A Hopfield memory: store patterns and text in the pulls, recall them from a damaged cue, keyed notes. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **numbers**: Real-valued things on springs, Langevin drift, solving linear systems. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **sdm**: Kanerva sparse distributed memory with hard locations and counters. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **sdmrefuse**: When a sparse distributed memory read should refuse to answer. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **sdmscale**: Sparse distributed memory at scale, up to a million locations. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **sdmtrack**: Predicted recall of a sparse distributed memory's content reads, without building the memory. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **softsdm**: Sparse distributed memory built from p-bits, with a soft cut-off. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **valleys**: Test landscapes; exact enumeration and random surveys of the calm arrangements. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **zoo**: Puzzles as models: sudoku, graph colouring, max-cut, factoring; checking a solution. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_
- **zootemp**: An anneal with a chosen schedule and restarts; judging a puzzle on the end state with `x.final`. _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/05-statements/README.md)_

## SETTLE token

- **comma**: `,` _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **dot**: `.` not followed by a digit, as in the . in rain.pulls _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **identifier**: a word, as in model, thing, settle, rain _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **label**: a word followed directly by `:`, as in by:, temperature:, seed: _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **number**: digits, with optional `_`, `.`, `e`, and a leading `-`, as in 2, 0.5, -1, 20_000, 1e3, .25 _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **string**: text between double quotes, as in "frame.pgm", "1... .4.. ..4. ...1" _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_
- **symbol**: `:` followed by a word, as in :rain, :wet_grass, :yes, :ising _(experiments/thermosim/settle-rs/docs/03-syntax.md)_

## site index: packages

- **JAX**: The Python library thrml is written in: thrml, Extropic's block Gibbs sampler, is a library in JAX. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#jax))_
- **KANERVA**: A Rust library that stores binary patterns in Kanerva's sparse distributed memory and reads them back from noisy read-addresses. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#kanerva-package))_
- **MCP**: settle-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server that lets an assistant read the SETTLE and KANERVA docs, set them up and run programs. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-mcp))_
- **SETTLE**: A small programming language for settling machines: you declare things, leans and pulls, then let them settle and count. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle))_
- **SETTLE TEXT**: settle-text, the React component library: text, images and vectors rendered as a live settle of lights, with no theory needed. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-text))_
- **settle-hear**: SETTLE's hearing library: it makes sound from a settle's own numbers. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-hear))_
- **settle-see**: SETTLE's seeing library: every picture it draws is a grid of p-bits settling out of noise into a word or a shape. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#settle-see))_
- **the MCP SDK**: The Model Context Protocol SDK: one of settle-mcp's two dependencies, the other being zod. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#mcp-sdk))_
- **THERMOSIM**: The folder the SETTLE campaign lives in, and its Python player: a simulated thermodynamic chip settling into video frames. _(sites/settle-site/src/wtf/terms.js (#/glossary#thermosim))_

## KANERVA word

- **refusing a never-stored read-address**: Refusing a never-stored read-address (REPORT_SDMREFUSE.md §2-3, REPORT_SDMTRACK.md §3-4). _(experiments/thermosim/kanerva/README.md)_
